title: zea perennis subsp. diploperennis
intro: Zea perennis subsp. diploperennis, commonly known as "Teosinte", is a perennial species of the genus Zea and is considered a wild relative of maize. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Teosinte are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for infections and inflammatory diseases. Bioactive constituents of Zea perennis subsp. diploperennis include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
